name: Ducks
description: Rate anything 0-4 ducks and write short reviews. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Adds user ratings (0 to 4 ducks, half ducks allowed) and optional short reviews to every movie, show, season and episode. Shows your rating and everyone's average on the details page, an average badge on posters, and a Reviews tab with a feed of all reviews. Data lives in Jellyfin's data folder with daily backups, so it survives server and plugin updates.
